reviews.text:
Fun way to share your step counts with friends. This neat little app has one good, focused use: share you walking and running step counts with friends and compete to ‘level up’ against each other. It achieves this in a fun and visually interesting way. 

If you find it crashes when loading Ads or if they get in the way then a small one-off payment gets rid of that problem.

The programmer is also very responsive to getting things fixed when needed.

Still crashes, even with the update. Nothing has changed with the update. It still crashes shortly after opening. You can even see when: there is a loading bar on the top of the screen. Usually once that’s coming to a full it crashes-sometimes even before that.

Great app but…. I don’t mind there being ads but every so often the ad is in an Asian language and there is no way to close it down. I got to the feedback screen, that was not a choice but one said the ad covered the app so I chose that. Now I have a blank screen with the notice that Google closed the ad which is hidden under the top black strip. If that were fixed, I would give it five stars

Done it again. This time showing an app I don’t want and cannot get rid of.

This app reminds me of a certain tech billionaire. Why? You might ask? Because it’s low information and cruel! 
Thought this might work for my Nordic skate skiing, so I tried it out since it promises to work for running. Got back from 75 minutes of skiing only to have the exact same inaccurate pedometer information as in my health app. Not only that, when I clicked for more information, the app informed me that I was lazy! So profoundly unhelpful! I deleted right away. I might not have written a review if it merely didn’t work.
Awesome app. Use it every day

Accuracy. Not very accurate. I do the exact sam course daily and it varies between 6.0-7.8 km. How bizarre

reviews.text: Good way to get motivated!. Great app to challenge yourself and others all within a well designed and simple to use app!

Motivating app. This is a good app, and motivating. 

One thing I'd really like, though, is to be able to set my own distance goals. At the moment I'm 4,547 Km through Rwanda - but that doesn't have meaning to me. 

It would be nice if I could set a distance, and name it myself. 1 lap around the base of Uluru, or, from Darwin to Melbourne, for example. That makes it more meaningful to me.

Inaccurate data. Disappointing that the app is not a correct representation of steps taken, it doesn’t update mine or my families steps at all sometimes or shows a figure that is not correct compared to my phone/Apple Watch. It will say my family are on 0 steps today but on their end they can see 9,000 steps taken that day. Very frustrating so I wouldn’t say this app is the best on the market at all, it’s a very basic or sub par experience. Definitely needs better programming in terms of how competitor apps are performing.
